To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the user-centered design process is a social process, and that the social process can only be understood by taking into account the social context of the design.

(a) the design of new financial services must be based on an understanding of the social context in which they will be used; (b) the design process must involve users and their social and cultural context from the outset; (c) the design of financial services should be based on a user-centered design approach that involves a combination of ethnographic fieldwork, participatory design workshops and iterative prototyping.
the design of financial services should take account of the social and cultural context within which they are to be used.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the design of financial services might be informed by a sociological perspective that focuses on the social practices of financial services users.
the social shaping of the Internet.
the social, economic and cultural aspects of financial services and the way these aspects are represented in the design of technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

it is possible to contribute a sociological perspective to the user-centered development of financial services, and that it is also possible to contribute to the development of a more sociologically informed approach to user-centered design.
the user-centered design approach was successful in the design of financial services.
the project has been very successful.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we were successful in contributing to the user-centered approach of the project and that the project was successful in providing a user-centered design approach.
the design of financial services can benefit from a sociological and anthropologist perspective.
we have found that the social and cultural context of financial services is important for their design and use.
The main takeaway from our work is that

sociological and anthropologically informed research can be useful for the development of financial services, but that this requires a careful consideration of the role of the social sciences in the process of design.
user-centered design can be enhanced by a focus on social and cultural factors in the design process.
user-centered design of complex systems is best done with an interdisciplinary team of social and computer scientists working in an iterative process of design, evaluation and reflection.
